title: Enable native encrypted desktop control on X11 Linux workstations.
changes: Add bounded owner-local X11 capture for XFCE and other Xorg desktops through a hash-pinned MSS wheel. Keep Wayland on its existing OS-consented Portal path.
Require a local display, an owner-private authority file, bounded primary-monitor geometry and one capture thread with explicit native cleanup. Reject remote X displays and XWayland override.
Preserve HPKE grants, session-bound input, private TURN delivery, heartbeat and Stop fencing. No new MCP tool definition or native binary bundle.
